goal: Serve the three typefaces from the site's own origin so the first paint never waits on a third-party stylesheet
context: Round 0002 removed the CSS @import, so the app stylesheet and the Google Fonts stylesheet now download in parallel instead of serially. But the Google Fonts sheet is still a render-blocking <link rel="stylesheet"> on a cold cross-origin host, so first paint still waits on DNS + TCP + TLS + CSS to fonts.googleapis.com. Verified in the built HTML (.output/public/index.html): the font stylesheet is emitted before the two preconnects, so the preconnect meant to warm fonts.googleapis.com lands after the request it was supposed to warm. Material fix: vendor the faces. The three families are served by Google as VARIABLE woff2, latin subset, so the whole set is only three files of about 100 KB total — roughly what the site already downloads today, minus two third-party origins. Exact source files (latin subset, verified reachable and valid wOF2, download them as-is with curl -fsSL): DM Sans https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/dmsans/v17/rP2Yp2ywxg089UriI5-g4vlH9VoD8Cmcqbu0-K4.woff2 (covers wght 400-700), JetBrains Mono https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/jetbrainsmono/v24/tDbv2o-flEEny0FZhsfKu5WU4zr3E_BX0PnT8RD8yKwBNntkaToggR7BYRbKPxDcwg.woff2 (wght 400-500), Manrope https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/manrope/v20/xn7gYHE41ni1AdIRggexSg.woff2 (wght 500-800). All three are OFL licensed. IMPORTANT: the site deploys under a base path — .github/workflows/docs.yml sets DOCS_BASE_PATH=/<repo-name>, so the build must resolve the font URLs with the base prefix (verified via `DOCS_BASE_PATH=/climier bun run build`).

targets.selector: docs/src/styles/app.css — where the families are consumed
targets.intent: Declare the three families locally with @font-face (font-display: swap, font-style: normal, and the proper font-weight range for each variable file) and free the app stylesheet from any third-party font dependency.
targets.notes: The family names MUST stay exactly "DM Sans", "Manrope" and "JetBrains Mono" — src/styles/theme.css maps --font-sans / --font-display / --font-mono to them and theme-parity.test.ts asserts those strings. Put the woff2 files where the bundler can hash and base-rewrite them (src/assets/fonts/ referenced with a relative url() is the safest for the base path); if you use public/ instead, prove the URL carries the base prefix under DOCS_BASE_PATH=/climier.

targets.intent: Remove the Google Fonts stylesheet and both font preconnects, and preload only the faces used above the fold so the first screen paints with the real typeface without blocking.
targets.notes: Preload only what the first viewport needs: the DM Sans file (body) and the Manrope file (hero and section headings). Do not preload the mono file — code blocks are below the fold and over-preloading is its own cost. Respect the base path for the preload hrefs too.

constraints: Family names and weights in use must not change: DM Sans 400/500/600/700, Manrope 500/600/700/800, JetBrains Mono 400/500. The variable files cover these ranges — do not add per-weight static files.
Zero third-party font requests at runtime: after the change, nothing in the built output may reference fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com.
Base-path safety is mandatory. `DOCS_BASE_PATH=/climier bun run build` must produce font URLs and preload hrefs that resolve under /climier/ — verify it, do not assume it.
Do not change any colour, size, spacing, radius, layout or copy. This round changes where the bytes come from, not how the page looks.
Do not touch docs/content/**, docs/src/components/**, or the CLI.
If a download fails, or you cannot make the URLs base-path safe, stop and report status "blocked" and revert your own change rather than leaving the site mixing a local face with the old remote one.

Hygiene: run `cd docs && bun run typecheck` — the command exists in docs/package.json and a previous round wrongly reported it as missing. Also run `cd docs && bun run test`. Report the exact commands and results in hygiene.
acceptanceCriteria: `cd docs && bun run build` succeeds, and `grep -r "fonts.googleapis\|fonts.gstatic" .output/public` returns nothing.
`DOCS_BASE_PATH=/climier bun run build` also succeeds and the emitted HTML and CSS reference the font files under the /climier/ prefix.
docs/src/styles/app.css contains no @import and no reference to a third-party font URL.
docs/src/routes/__root.tsx declares no Google Fonts stylesheet and no font preconnect; it declares preloads for the body and heading faces with as="font", type="font/woff2" and crossorigin.

In the browser, document.fonts.check('400 16px "DM Sans"'), document.fonts.check('700 16px "Manrope"') and document.fonts.check('400 12px "JetBrains Mono"') are all true, and computed styles resolve body to DM Sans, landing headings and #nd-page h1/h2 to Manrope, and code/pre/kbd to JetBrains Mono.
No request to fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com appears in the Network panel / resource timing after a hard reload.
Cumulative layout shift on load stays 0.
qualityChecks: Three variable files, not ten static ones — the simplest asset set that covers every weight in use.
font-display: swap with an explicit reason in the response; text must never be invisible while a face is pending.
Preload limited to the two above-the-fold faces; the mono file is fetched on demand.
The @font-face declarations carry a short comment naming the source and the licence, so the vendored binaries are traceable.
No dead CSS: nothing left referencing a remote family, no duplicate @font-face for the same family and range.
The fallback stack in theme.css still ends in a sensible generic family, so a failed font load degrades gracefully.
regressionChecks: Landing /: hero headline, section headings, body copy, mono labels and the status panel are typographically identical to the before shot — same family, weight, metrics and line breaks.
Docs /docs/getting-started/quickstart and /docs/reference/cli: prose, headings, inline code and code blocks render identically, including code block line breaks.
Narrow viewport (390x844): no text reflow or clipping.
The vendored files are actually valid: the page shows no fallback-face rendering anywhere after load settles.

visualGaps.observed: A render-blocking third-party stylesheet still gates the first paint on a cold cross-origin connection, and its preconnect is emitted after it in the head so it never warms it.
visualGaps.expected: Font bytes come from the site's own origin; no third-party font request at runtime; first paint no longer waits on fonts.googleapis.com.
